SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date. November 15, 1933

Subject (in full) Communist Propaganda found in Y'poo and Louza Districts.

Made by D.I. Kuh Tao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

Intelligence Sent of 15/11-33

During the afternoon of November 11 two small red flags bearing the insignia of the Union of Soviet Socialistic Republics were found by the Municipal Police on Kwangshin and Linching Roads respectively.

A number of coloured leaflets printed in the Chinese language were found by the Municipal Police on Nanking Road near Fokien Road at 4.70 p.m. November 11. The leaflets, which are believed to have emanated from communistic sources, denounce the Kuomintang as being in league with foreign imperialists and state that the task of overthrowing the imperialists in China rests with the Red Army.

Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

November 15, 15 / 31 / 22.

Political

Movement of Notables
From Nanking
Arrived at 7.30 a.m. November 15 :-
Li Shih-cha, Vice Minister of Navy.
Lieu Zeu-heng, Minister of Health.

Communist Propaganda
During the afternoon of November 12 two small
red flags bearing the insignia of the Union of Soviet
Socialistic Republics were found by the Municipal Police
on Kwangshin and Linching Roads respectively.
A number of coloured leaflets printed in the
Chinese language were found by the Municipal Police on
Nanking Road near Fokien Road at 4.30 p.m. November 11.
The leaflets, which are believed to have emanated from
communist sources, denounce the Kuomintang as being in
league with foreign imperialists and state that the task
of overthrowing the imperialists in China rests with the
Red Army.

Commander of the Liaoning National Salvation Army
- office established in French Concession
